questions.prompt: I admire this in the general, that he never abandons his soldiers.

questions.prompt: The Athenians will not be satisfied with the ambassadors in these matters.

questions.prompt: I wonder at the citizens, that they praise those who are willing to die for freedom.

questions.prompt: This one thing I censure in you, that you obey no one.

questions.prompt: I suspect this in the tyrant, that he distrusts his friends.
questions.answer: ὑπονοῶ τοῦτο τοῦ τυράννου, ὅτι τοῖς φίλοις ἀπιστεῖ.

questions.answer: ἐνθυμοῦ τοῦτο τοῦ ποιητοῦ, ὡς δεξιῶς τοὺς λόγους συνέθηκεν.

questions.prompt: I admire those who are willing to endure toils for the sake of glory.
questions.answer: θαυμάζω τῶν ὑπὲρ δόξης τοὺς πόνους ὑπομένειν ἐθελόντων.

questions.prompt: The soldiers admired their commander and gladly followed him.

questions.answer: ὁ βασιλεὺς τῶν στρατιωτῶν ἐθεώρει ὡς προθύμως ἀγωνίζοιντο.

questions.prompt: I was amazed at the orators, how boldly they addressed the people.
